{{split|{{redlink|Professor Carolina}} and [[Celestic Town Elder]]}} {{CharInfobox| color=525252 | corecolor=8F8F8F | bordercolor=353535 | name=Professor Carolina | jname=カラシナ博士 | tmname=Dr. Karashina | text=white | slogan=no | image=Prof Carolina.png | size=250px | caption=Professor Carolina | gender=Female | colors=yes | eyes=Gray | hair=Gray-blonde | hometown=[[Celestic Town]] | region=[[Sinnoh]] | relatives=[[Cynthia]] (granddaughter) | trainer=yes | trainerclass=[[Pokémon Professor]] | game=no | leader=no | anime=yes | epnum=DP096 | epname=Losing Its Lustrous! | enva=[[Rebecca Soler]] | java=Ai Satō | }} '''Professor Carolina''' (Japanese: '''カラシナ博士''' ''Dr. Karashina'') is a [[Pokémon Professor]] who appears in {{aniseries|DP}}. She is [[Cynthia]]'s grandmother. She also appears in the {{pkmn|games}} and in multiple {{pkmn|manga}}, but is not referred to by name. ==In animation== [[File:Cynthia and Professor Carolina.png|left|thumb|250px|Professor Carolina and her granddaughter]] ===History=== ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== Professor Carolina is the head of the [[Celestic Town Historical Research Center]], leading research into the [[Sinnoh]] time-space legends. She debuted in ''[[DP096|Losing Its Lustrous!]]'' and ''[[DP097|Double Team Turnover!]]'', where [[Team Galactic]] managed to steal the [[Lustrous Orb]] from the Research Center. Carolina was showing the Lustrous Orb to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} at the time before Team Galactic put their plan into action. She reported the incident to the authorities, but was unaware that her close friend and fellow researcher [[Cyrus]] was the head of Team Galactic and behind the plot. In ''[[DP111|Saving the World From Ruins!]]'', Professor Carolina arrived at the {{si|Iron Ruins}} on [[Iron Island]] following the disturbance caused by Team Galactic's activities in the area. She revealed that stones that make up Iron Island and the [[Veilstone City]] meteorites were the same material. Carolina enlisted the help of [[Riley]] to continue her research. She reappeared in ''[[DP151|The Needs of the Three!]]'', where she was at [[Lake Acuity]], working in combination with [[Professor Rowan]] and {{Gary}} to keep the three {{an|lake guardians}} safe from Team Galactic. However much of the action took place at [[Lake Valor]], where [[Hunter J]] aided Galactic {{tc|Commander}} [[Saturn]] in capturing all three lake guardians. Team Galactic's ultimate scheme was defeated in ''[[DP152|The Battel Finale of Legend!]]'' thanks to the group and {{an|Cynthia}}. Afterwards, Gary managed to secure the stolen [[Adamant Orb|Adamant]] and Lustrous Orbs, and he planned to take them back to Professor Carolina and the Celestic Town Historical Research Center. ===Character=== Professor Carolina is a very outspoken lady and even directly asked {{Ash}} to battle her granddaughter, {{an|Cynthia}}. She is very proud of her granddaughter's status as [[Sinnoh]]'s {{pkmn|Champion}}, telling Ash that he would have to train a lot harder if he wanted to beat Cynthia. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color=525252|bordercolor=8F8F8F |ja= さとうあい ''Ai Satō'' |en=[[Rebecca Soler]] |fi=Heljä Heikkinen ([[DP096]]-[[DP097]], [[DP111]])

Once the player arrives in [[Celestic Town]], the grandmother tells the story of the [[lake guardians]]. In the games, once the player has faced {{p|Dialga}} or {{p|Palkia}}, she will show a picture of {{p|Dialga}} or {{p|Palkia}}, depending on which version is played. This only registers the Pokémon as "seen" in the [[Pokédex]] and does not add an entry. In {{v2|Platinum}}, as witnessing the events at the [[Spear Pillar]] adds both Dialga and Palkia to the Pokédex, she will instead inform the player of their ability to catch Dialga and Palkia if they own their respective orbs. ===Quotes=== ===={{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}}==== ;Celestic Town :''"There’s an odd spaceman in front of the ruins. {{color2|fff|Generation IV}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Cynthia grandmother Adventures.png|150px|thumb|Cynthia's grandmother in Pokémon Adventures manga]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== Cynthia's grandmother first appeared in ''[[PS367|Suffering Psyduck]]'', where {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} encountered her at [[Café Cabin]], drinking her favorite drink, [[Moomoo Milk]]. In ''[[PS368|Problematic Probopass and Mad Magnezone I]]'', she led the three through the foggy part of {{rt|210|Sinnoh}} to [[Celestic Town]], telling them the [[Sinnoh myths|legend]] of Sinnoh's three lakes and the {{adv|lake guardians}} on the way. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== It was revealed that she was the one who had created the meteor-filled craters in [[Veilstone City]] while training to use {{m|Draco Meteor}} during her younger years. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |width=80 |trainer=Cynthia's grandmother |pkmn=Chingling |type1=Psychic |img=Cynthia grandmother Chingling Adventures.png |epnum=PS367 |epname=Suffering Psyduck |desc={{p|Chingling}} usually serves as a hatpiece for Cynthia's grandmother. None of Chingling's moves are known.}} =====Borrowed===== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Cynthia |pkmn=Garchomp |gender=female |type1=Dragon |type2=Ground |img=Cynthia Garchomp Adventures.png |epnum=PS347 |epname=Ring Around the Roserade II |desc={{p|Garchomp}} is one of Cynthia's Pokémon and her main battler. In ''[[PS367|Suffering Psyduck]]'', Cynthia lent Garchomp to her Grandmother so that she, Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum could make it to [[Celestic Town]] safely. }} [[File:Cynthia grandmother DPA.png|180px|thumb|Cynthia's grandmother in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga]] ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== Cynthia's grandmother appeared in the [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] manga in a role similar to her in the games. She is first shown in ''[[DPA07|Dialga's Secret Keys]]'', where she tried to expel members of Team Galactic from Celestic Town.
